messages.subject: SEM Categorial Outcome Variable Help
parts:
Hello, I'm hoping for some advice with a bit of syntax that was working fine, until I realized that I needed to tell R that these variables were ordinal. Once I added the ordered argument to the fit syntax below, I started getting this error: "Error in tmp[cbind(row..idx, col..idx)] <- 1 : subscript out of bounds"
I've also included my model syntax.

modelF <- 'ALCDEPS~DUM_MO+DUM_AO
           MRJDEPS~DUM_MO+DUM_AO
           IRSEX~~ALCDEPS+MRJDEPS   
           INCOME~~ALCDEPS+MRJDEPS 
           AGE~~ALCDEPS+MRJDEPS'

mFfit <- sem(modelF, group="RACE_4", data=Data,
              ordered=c("ALCDEPS","MRJDEPS"))

Many thanks in advance. 

Devin
